query:
UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'Various (showrunners: Doug Petrie, Marco Ramirez)',
  `cast` = 'Charlie Cox as Matt Murdock / Daredevil, Krysten Ritter as Jessica Jones, Mike Colter as Luke Cage, Finn Jones as Danny Rand / Iron Fist, Sigourney Weaver as Alexandra, Elodie Yung as Elektra, Scott Glenn as Stick',
  tagline = 'Four heroes. One city. The team-up event that brought Hell''s Kitchen''s finest together.',
  description = 'The Defenders brings together Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, and Iron Fist as they are forced to unite against The Hand, a shadowy organization threatening to destroy New York City, in this 8-episode miniseries crossover event.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/defenders-featured-cnGQuJmNpwjJAYWTsCRPcn.webp',
  episodeCount = 8,
  seasonCount = 1,
  platform = 'Netflix',
  rtCriticsScore = 74,
  rtAudienceScore = 72,
  verdict = 'mixed',
  cardMarketContent = '## Defenders Cards: The Crossover Premium

The Defenders crossover event created the definitive Netflix Marvel card set. **2018 Upper Deck The Defenders** is the most collected Netflix-era product, featuring all four heroes together for the first time. Team-up cards showing all four Defenders command the highest premiums, while Sigourney Weaver as Alexandra cards are unique collectibles from a legendary actress in the Marvel universe.',
  keyCards = '- **2018 Upper Deck Defenders Team Card** — All four heroes together, the chase card of the set, $15-35
- **2018 Upper Deck Defenders Sigourney Weaver Alexandra** — Legendary actress in Marvel, $8-20
- **2018 Upper Deck Defenders Elektra Black Sky** — Key villain card, $5-15
- **2018 Upper Deck Defenders Complete Base Set** — Full 90-card set, $30-60',
  content = '## The Netflix Avengers Assemble

The Defenders was Netflix Marvel''s equivalent of The Avengers — the crossover event that brought four solo heroes together. While it didn''t quite reach the heights of its best individual series, the chemistry between the four leads was undeniable. Watching Jessica Jones mock Danny Rand while Luke Cage played peacemaker was exactly the dynamic fans wanted.

## Sigourney Weaver''s Alexandra

Casting Sigourney Weaver as the primary villain was a statement of intent. Her Alexandra brought gravitas and menace to The Hand, even if the character''s arc was cut shorter than expected. The twist involving Elektra''s Black Sky transformation gave the miniseries its emotional core.

## The Restaurant Scene

The moment all four Defenders finally sit down together in a Chinese restaurant is one of Netflix Marvel''s most iconic scenes. The banter, the reluctance, the slow realization that they need each other — it was earned through years of solo storytelling.

## Fun Facts

- The show was filmed simultaneously with portions of other Defenders shows
- Each hero was associated with a color: red (Daredevil), blue (Jessica), yellow (Luke), green (Danny)
- Sigourney Weaver took the role specifically because she''d never done a superhero project
- The 8-episode format was chosen to avoid the pacing issues of 13-episode seasons
- The hallway fight with all four heroes was the most complex action sequence Netflix Marvel ever attempted',
  metaDescription = 'The Defenders (2017) complete guide — team-up analysis, Sigourney Weaver spotlight, trading card market values, key cards to collect, and the Netflix Avengers legacy.',
  keywords = 'the defenders, netflix marvel, daredevil, jessica jones, luke cage, iron fist, sigourney weaver, marvel cards, crossover',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Defenders 2018 cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Do I need to watch all four solo shows before The Defenders?","answer":"Ideally yes. The Defenders assumes knowledge of Daredevil S1-2, Jessica Jones S1, Luke Cage S1, and Iron Fist S1. At minimum, watch Daredevil and Jessica Jones for the best experience."},{"question":"Is The Defenders canon to the MCU?","answer":"Yes, all Netflix Marvel shows are now confirmed MCU canon, with characters from these shows appearing in Disney+ series and MCU films."},{"question":"Why was The Defenders only 8 episodes?","answer":"Marvel and Netflix deliberately chose a shorter format to maintain tighter pacing and avoid the ''Netflix bloat'' that affected some 13-episode seasons."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'the-defenders-2017'
